Its Prin. Secy. Deptt. Home U.P. Civil Secrt. Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Mohd. Waris Farooqui
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Counter affidavit filed today is taken on record.
2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
None turned up on behalf of the complainant despite service of notice.
3. In terms of the FIR, it was alleged that the daughter of the informant was missing and was enticed away by the applicant.

In the statement of the victim recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C., the victim did not support the prosecution story and stated that she knew the applicant for the last three years and she has scolded by her parents as such, she went along with the applicant to Mumbai.

In the Abdul Jahid vs State Of U.P. Thru. Its Prin. Secy. ... on 16 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/150248904/

entities.text: Abdul Jahid vs State Of U.P. Thru. Its Prin. Secy
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The tentative age of the victim is 18 years.
The applicant has no criminal history and is in custody since 19.04.2022.
4. Learned A.G.A. opposed the bail prayer.

5. Considering the aforesaid two statements of the victim recorded under Section 161 & 164 Cr.P.C.
coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal history and is in custody since 19.04.2022 and there is nothing on record to demonstrate that the applicant if enlarged on bail, would in any way adversely affect the trial and without expressing any opinion on merit, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Abdul Jahid be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No. 37 of 2022, under Sections 363, 366, 376 IPC and Section 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station Kotwali Utraula, District Balrampur, on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 16.2.2024
